pre_caption: The video starts as a full shot from a level angle, with a man positioned in the center middle ground. As the camera moves forward and tilts upward into a low-angle perspective, the framing tightens to a medium shot, keeping the man as the central focus. This movement reveals a seated woman in the bottom left midground and maintains the view of another seated woman in the bottom right midground, both positioned slightly behind the man. During the low-angle view, the colorful ceiling fills the top of the frame. The shot then begins to reverse, pulling back to transition from the medium shot toward the initial full shot and level-angle framing.
